summary: Iteration 21 — Admin visual refresh verified. /admin now renders inside AppShell (collapsible Bracket sidebar with Dashboard/Settings/FAQ/Admin[active]). Section-label 'Admin console' + t-hero 'Bracket, at a glance.' + muted subtitle render exactly as spec. Tabs (admin-tab-analytics, admin-tab-users) switch content and use --accent border-bottom on active. Analytics: 6 KPI cards + 7 recharts SVGs rendered, 14 card-brut containers, Refresh button uses .btn-ghost. Users: card-brut list, search works, admin pill uses --accent tint, Reset PW + VIEW buttons render on rows. Project detail modal opens, uses card-brut, closes correctly via ESC + backdrop + X. Reset password modal uses card-brut with section-label 'Reset password' + btn-brut/btn-ghost. Regression clean: /admin/login has NO sidebar (standalone), /app dashboard still has AppShell sidebar and renders. Backend endpoints (login, /admin/analytics, /admin/users) all 200.

issues:
KPI labels render visually as ALL-CAPS ('TOTAL USERS', 'NEW · 7D', 'TOTAL PROJECTS', 'LOCKED', 'ACCEPT RATE', 'AVG STEPS') because AdminAnalytics.jsx applies `text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider` to Kpi label

elements (source text is 'Total users' but text-transform:uppercase inverts it). Review request explicitly stated 'KPI labels use sentence case ("Total users" not "TOTAL USERS")'. Either drop the `uppercase` class from lines 77, 119, 321, 327 of AdminAnalytics.jsx to genuinely match sentence-case intent, or acknowledge the metadata-uppercase pattern is intentional. Same applies to section subtitle 'LIVE SNAPSHOT · UPDATED ...' and 'SIGNUPS PER DAY · LAST 30 DAYS' — visually uppercase.

Recharts emits a non-fatal warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (~14 times) during initial mount of ResponsiveContainer'd charts. Charts render fine after layout settles but the warning is noisy. Consider giving ResponsiveContainer a fixed aspect or explicit height.

action_items: Decide: sentence-case KPI labels per PRD (remove `uppercase` class in AdminAnalytics.jsx lines 77, 119, 321, 327), OR update the request wording to reflect that visual uppercase is the site's small-label pattern. Current build renders 'TOTAL USERS' visually, which contradicts the stated intent.
(Optional) Silence Recharts 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings by setting explicit minWidth/minHeight or fixed height on ResponsiveContainer instances.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx line 18-22 has legacy STATUS_COLOR map referencing text-chalk/text-signal classes that are no longer used anywhere (STATUS_TAG replaced it). Dead code — safe to delete.
AdminDashboard.jsx line 115-122 has an unused `logout` function followed by `void logout;` to silence the linter. Should be removed since sign-out is handled by AppShell now.

AdminDashboard.jsx useEffect (line 57-61) depends only on `tab` but references `users.length` and `error` — dependency array is incomplete (React would warn). Since the intent is fire-once-on-tab-activation it works, but consider a `hasLoadedRef` for clarity.
AdminAnalytics.jsx retains `uppercase tracking-wider` on KPI labels — directly contradicts the sentence-case commitment in the review request.
